notes: PRRI American Values Survey, distributed by ARDA. Pilot: immigration 2018–2024 and marriage 2023–2024. Valid answers use original annual full-sample weights; missing responses excluded. Other acquired questions remain unreviewed.

entries.title: Immigration: citizenship, legal residency or deportation
entries.question: Which statement comes closest to your view about how the immigration system should deal with immigrants who are currently living in the U.S. illegally?
entries.question_note: Citizenship = +1; permanent legal residency without citizenship = 0; deportation = -1. The midpoint is a scoring convention, not ideological neutrality.
entries.weight: Annual full-sample survey weight; see year provenance
